feedback.problem: If $cot⁡x=-4$ for some $x,$ then find the value of $3cot⁡(x+17\pi )+6.$
feedback.worked_solution:
The period of $y=cot⁡x$ is $\pi .$ Therefore, for any integer $n,$ we have

$$
cot⁡x=cot⁡(x+n\pi ).
$$

Substituting $n=17$ into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}cot⁡x & =cot⁡(x+17\cdot \pi ) \\  & =cot⁡(x+17\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $cot⁡x=-4,$ then $cot⁡(x+17\pi )=-4.$

Finally, then

$$
\begin{aligned}3cot⁡(x+7\pi )+6 & =3(-4)+6 \\  & =-12+6 \\  & =-6.\end{aligned}
$$
